description: Semantic genome for basicbrowserslim SPA runtime. Contains the minimal set of behavioral invariants required to regenerate observable behavior under valid transformations. Each gene is evidence-backed and invalidatable. Transform laws are only valid when the genes they cite remain verified. Genes with proof_class 'violated' are aspirational invariants that are not yet enforced in the current codebase; they are included so a static-recompiler agent knows what to fix.

genes.subject: surfaceManager.buildSurface
genes.statement: buildSurface(si, ii, phase) always resolves to surface|null, never rejects. Failures are caught internally and normalize to null. Callers never need try/catch.
genes.observable_effect: Rasterization failures degrade gracefully to a no-animation fallback; they never crash a transition.
invalidated_by: any change that causes rasterizeHero to reject without internal catch
removal of the try/catch in buildSurface

genes.subject: appKernel._computeUiState
genes.statement: Visible UI state is a pure function of (_phase, overlay.isOpen()). The state domain is: 'idle' | 'transitioning' | 'pulling' | 'overlay'. _computeUiState is authoritative. body.dataset.{state,section,item} are its derived outputs via _syncUiState.
genes.observable_effect: CSS and external code reading body.dataset.state see a value that is always consistent with runtime phase.
invalidated_by: addition of a new phase or state value without updating _computeUiState
any direct write to body.dataset.state outside _syncUiState

genes.subject: appKernel._render
genes.statement: _render() calls heroRenderer.renderHeroDOM + navRenderer.updateSectionNav + navRenderer.updateItemDots + _syncUiState atomically. It is the only valid full-commit path for a new (_si, _ii) position.
genes.observable_effect: Hero DOM, section nav, item dots, and body.dataset are always in sync after a position commit.
invalidated_by: any code path that updates hero or nav state without calling _render or all four of its sub-calls
addition of new nav/hero sync side-effects not reflected in _render

genes.subject: appKernel._withTransition + transitionKernel.runTransition
genes.statement: All transitions follow the phase grammar: capture(surfaces) → animate(particles) → reveal(handoff) → commit/cleanup. _withTransition enforces idle→transitioning→idle bracketing around every run, including on failure.
genes.observable_effect: _phase is never left in 'transitioning' after a transition completes or throws. body.dataset.state always reflects the post-transition phase.
invalidated_by: any transition that bypasses _withTransition and sets _phase directly
removal of the finally block in _withTransition
change to reveal handoff ordering in transitionKernel

genes.subject: retained DOM ↔ immediate-mode canvas handoff
genes.statement: The live hero DOM element and the transition canvas are distinct rendering domains. transitionKernel switches between them via hideHero+showCanvas (enter particle domain) and _revealHandoff (return to DOM domain). They must never be simultaneously visible outside the cross-fade window.
genes.observable_effect: No visual double-rendering. The hero element is hidden exactly during particle animation and revealed only after the canvas fades out.
invalidated_by: any code that shows the hero element while the canvas is also displayed with opacity > 0, outside the cross-fade transition
any new rendering domain added without a corresponding hide/show operator in transitionKernel

genes.subject: surfaceManager.startTracking / stopTracking
genes.statement: stopTracking and startTracking are symmetric lifecycle operators. stopTracking cancels any deferred RAF and clears _trackingKey. startTracking calls stopTracking first, then re-primes the surface cache after one RAF (skipped for GIF/view-probe heroes). Every stopTracking must eventually have a paired startTracking or the cache is permanently stale.
genes.observable_effect: The cached hero surface is always fresh when a transition begins. Transitions never use stale surfaces from a prior position.
invalidated_by: any _withTransition call with stopTracking:true that does not also set startTracking:true or manually call startTracking
change to the deferred RAF timing in startTracking

genes.subject: transitionKernel — hero visibility ownership
genes.statement: transitionKernel should own all transient hero visibility mutations. hideHero is the canonical operator for suppressing the hero during particle animation. No module outside transitionKernel should set heroEl.style.visibility or heroEl.style.opacity directly.
genes.observable_effect: Hero visibility state is always the result of a canonical operator, never of ad-hoc style mutation.

violated_at.note: cancelSlingshot sets heroEl.style.visibility/opacity directly instead of via a canonical showHero operator

invalidated_by: any new direct heroEl.style.visibility or heroEl.style.opacity assignment outside transitionKernel
export of heroContainer to a module that is not transitionKernel
genes.remediation: Add showHero() to transitionKernel and use it in cancelSlingshot instead of the direct style assignment.

genes.subject: navModel public API
genes.statement: navModel's only public export is getTargetForDirection. getAvailableSections, getNextTarget, and getPrevTarget are module-private helpers. appKernel is the sole consumer of the public API.
genes.observable_effect: Navigation target computation is fully encapsulated; external modules cannot depend on internal helpers.
invalidated_by: addition of any new export from navModel
a second module importing from navModel other than appKernel

genes.subject: probe lifecycle and feature identity
genes.statement: Probes should be feature-owned, runtime-consumed. Feature modules own probe creation and cleanup via buildHeroProbe. appKernel consumes probes but must not hardcode feature identities (no string literal 'games' in transition paths, no direct window.__SPA_Views['games'] calls).
genes.observable_effect: New feature types add a probe builder to the feature module; appKernel transition paths gain zero new conditionals.
invalidated_by: addition of any further feature-specific string literal or conditional in appKernel transition paths
probe cleanup moved out of the feature module into appKernel
genes.remediation: Route game mount calls through __SPA_GameNav or a view hook so appKernel has no feature-specific string literals.

transform_laws.name: dead-catch elimination
transform_laws.statement: A try/catch around Promise.all([...inputs]) is removable without trace divergence if every input promise satisfies surf-001.
transform_laws.witness: goTo at appKernel.js:113 wraps Promise.all with a try/catch that is only needed if buildSurface could reject — surf-001 says it cannot.

transform_laws.name: dead-export elimination
transform_laws.statement: An export keyword on a function is removable if zero modules outside the file import that name.
transform_laws.witness: navModel.js exports getAvailableSections/getNextTarget/getPrevTarget which are used only within navModel itself. They can be unexported once nav-001 is verified.

transform_laws.name: ownership consolidation
transform_laws.statement: A direct DOM mutation in module A is movable to module B if B already owns that DOM subtree per the ownership genome, and the mutation is functionally symmetric to an existing operator in B.
transform_laws.witness: cancelSlingshot's heroEl.style.* assignment (appKernel.js:379-380) is equivalent to a showHero() operator that transitionKernel should expose alongside hideHero().

transform_laws.name: phenotype extraction
transform_laws.statement: Two code paths are collapsible into a shared helper if their runtime traces are equivalent under the behavioral genes, differing only in a hook parameter (e.g., onReveal callback).
transform_laws.witness: closeOverlayWithTransition (appKernel.js:180-192) and exitGameToCurrentItem (appKernel.js:220-231) share the same surface-pair + runTransition + startTracking pattern and differ only in the onBeforeReveal hook.

transform_laws.name: render target canonicalization
transform_laws.statement: Any code path that calls heroRenderer.renderHeroDOM + navRenderer.updateSectionNav + navRenderer.updateItemDots outside _render is collapsible into a _render() call (or a helper that performs all three), provided _syncUiState is also called or already scheduled.
transform_laws.witness: onRelease at appKernel.js:356-360 and goTo's onBeforeReveal at appKernel.js:127-130 both manually repeat the three render calls instead of calling _render.
